dedupe_keys.name: region hauts de france road datasets

description: Région Hauts-de-France: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région Hauts-de-France. Coverage: Région Hauts-de-France. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Arrêts, horaires et parcours théoriques (GTFS) du réseau routier régio; Réseau Routier d’Intérêt Régional (RRIR) - SRADDET 2020; Réseau routier principal (autoroutes et nationales) (SRADDET 2020-08) ; Feuilles de route numérique en Région Hauts-de-France. Formats seen: OGC:WMS, 0-HTTP--LINK, OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
